summary: A man died Saturday on Longs Peak; Rocky Mountain National Park rangers recovered his body about 5 p.m. Sunday above the Ledges section of the Keyhole Route, forcing a temporary closure of the route from the Keyhole 1.5 miles to the summit. Name not released.
location: above the Ledges, Keyhole Route, Longs Peak, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: ndinsider/Coloradoan (opened run 599): died Saturday 2022-09-17 (verified Saturday), body recovered Sunday ~5 p.m. above the Ledges. Circumstances of death not stated in source. Boulder = east-side inference (Ledges lie just past the Keyhole on the east/summit approach), flagged.
